single_factor_rules: cost changes both the fixed formula threshold 2*c and actual fee rate; B and delay fixed. Budget changes B alone. Delay shifts the entire saved prediction/target one equity session without refitting. No Cartesian grid.
gross_definition: rerun identical BASE targets with zero execution fees, keeping mu filter at original c=.0005; distinct from cost_0bp scenario that also changes the filter to mu>0

account_scopes.full: cash anchor on previous equity session; first allowed execution 2020-01-02; all 12 accounts reset to 100000
account_scopes.common: first execution at common forecast availability; reset all 12 accounts to 100000 with preceding information retained
account_scopes.delay_common_pair: delayed common first execution is one session later; rerun BASE reference from exactly that later start for paired delay attribution; do not truncate an existing account

terminal: mark at 2023 final close, no forced sale, no 2024 return, pending delayed orders reported
missing_signal: no order; retain actual shares/cash, corporate actions and PnL continue

metrics.exposure: old close weight on return-bearing account days; initial execution day weight is zero; also show closing weights and distribution
metrics.drawdown: includes initial capital anchor, so initial fee can create drawdown
metrics.five_day: worst compounded 5 consecutive account-return sessions, no overlapping position trades
metrics.missed_upside: sum((1-old_weight)*max(asset_return,0)); arithmetic opportunity diagnostic, not additive compounded performance

exposure_match: POST_HOC_ONLY; fixed target=observed mean old weight*n/(n-1), which exactly matches return-bearing mean exposure after common cash anchor; all accounts rerun independently, not executable ex ante
case_selection: POST_HOC: primary M2 main vs fixed100 on base common scope; rank entry-close through next5-closes normalized actual continuous-account return difference, include entry rebalance fee; two largest and two smallest, greedily exclude overlapping entry/end intervals; report all selected rows, not label-trade sums
risk_underestimate_diagnostic: compute entry-relative subsequent five-close asset loss only where entirely before2024; compare saved q90 and static risk capacity*loss to B; does not alter holdings or claim continuous-account guarantee
